effect: advance the pc by the instruction length; nothing else (the common tail every handler returns through)
inert: shares the invalid-opcode target 0x0025E60A (marks the tick finished and advances)

halt: set actor +0x14 bit 0x40 and rewind the pc to the instruction (0x0025E607); while the bit is set the interpreter returns at its entry check, and request selection clears the bit when it selects an entry (0x003DB774)
pop one value and discard it
logical OR: pop b, pop a (int, floats truncated), push (a != 0 or b != 0)
arithmetic shift right: push a >> b (sar)
add: int + int as int, otherwise float (addss)
subtract: int or float path (0x00267560 selects)
divide: int (idiv) or float (divss); a zero divisor is tested on both paths and yields 0; the float test is ordered (a NaN divisor divides) and INT_MIN / -1 is not tested
remainder: int idiv only, with NO zero test - MOD 0 faults; INT_MIN MOD -1 faults too, because nothing is tested before the idiv
inert (shares 0x0025E60A) - unary minus is not implemented
request: pop (channel, function id, actor) and file a kind-0, mode-1 request
request kind 0, mode 2 (start-wait: the requester parks as wait kind 4 until the target starts)
request kind 0, mode 3 (end-wait: parks until the target's function returns)
pop three values; no request is filed
return: retire the active entry, select the next pending one, and resume the caller's wait slot (or service the wait state when no wait is outstanding)
return N: pop a depth and recycle the entry range above it, then resume as RET
return and transfer: as RET, and start the next entry's script (0x003DBDC0)
wait for a request: pop (function id, actor); if that actor has the entry active, park as wait kind 3 on it
pop two values; no wait is armed
set an actor's resource-override slot: pop (value, actor, slot) into 0x0025AF60; slots 0x10-0x11 re-arm the EH-5 countdown when the target's +0x0B bit 0x8 is set
cancel: pop an index and recycle the entry range above it (0x003DB420)
pop into per-actor int register I0 (record +0x64)
pop one value and hand it to the ret-0 stub 0x0016D6A0 - inert
push a variable (resolved by descriptor; width and int/float from the descriptor)
pop into a variable, coerced to its kind
resolve a variable for the debug print path
push a variable reference (how an array element is passed)

push tag k of the actor the latest PUSHACT named: 0x02099AB8 selects entry (index + 1) x 16 of the slot's +0x80 table, [slot + 0] + its dword is that actor's tag table, dword [k x 8 + 8] is pushed (0x8000 past its count)
push the packed actor handle of the operand's actor index ((word << 16) | index | bit 0x4000; 0x8000 when out of range)
push the int constant the operand indexes in the slot's pool (+0x68)
push the float constant the operand indexes in the slot's pool (+0x70)
jump to bytecode base + the script's jump table[operand]
pop v; jump if v == Y
pop v; jump if v > Y
pop v; jump if v >= Y
pop v; jump if v < Y
pop v; jump if v <= Y
pop two bounds, order them, jump if Y is at least the lower bound and at most the higher (0x0026194E-0x0026195B)
call native verb [operand] with X = the actor's own index; if the verb yields, rewind and save the pc so the call repeats next tick
as CALL, but first pop the target actor into X (skipped while the context is resuming, +0x15)
pop into X; jump if non-zero
pop into X; jump if zero (the for-loop idiom)
as CALL, and when the verb completes pop its result into register A
as CALLACT, and when the verb completes pop its result into register A
request on a whole actor list (waits while any listed actor still has the channel active)
wait on a whole actor list (wait kind 5)
peek three values (pop and push back) and mark the target's channel as requested (0x002659F0: +0x24 bit, +0x10 count) without filing a request
